==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged.

== Notes ==
* This skill requires exactly 160 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 6 strikes and 10 units.
* Combine with [[Heavy Blow]] to keep your target knocked down.

== Trivia==
* This skill has the lowest adrenaline cost of any Warrior skill that causes knock down without prerequisites or side effects (e.g. losing all adrenaline).
